title: Observability and Application Monitoring
description: Monitor Azure applications with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, KQL, metrics, alerts, and distributed tracing.
longDescription: This module teaches observability for Azure applications. You will learn how to instrument apps with Application Insights, query logs with KQL in Log Analytics, create metrics alerts and action groups, trace distributed requests, and monitor Functions, App Service, and containers.
whatYouLearn: Query logs and metrics with KQL in Log Analytics
Create metrics alerts and action groups
Monitor Functions, App Service, and AKS workloads
Diagnose application health and performance issues
